text.tspan: in a brownout, the priority is to add capacity
shed at about the same CPU target that triggers scaling
and the signal never comes, or comes late (AWS).
Netflix (2024): shed only above the autoscaling CPU target
fast rejections drag latency down: shed 60% and the median
might look pretty amazing while successful requests are terrible (AWS)

g.text: 4 · your priority labels can be wrong

text.tspan: Netflix: a low-priority request, when shed, triggered a race condition
on Android and iOS (sporadic playback errors). Test shedding on purpose
a refused client that retries at once comes back:
client-side retry budgets + backoff with jitter
hedged requests add load (hedge with headroom, shed without)
